snippet.title: Black Jacket - Official Developer Overview Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Here's a look at the Developer Overview Trailer for Black Jacket, a roguelike deckbuilding game developed by Mi'pu'mi Games. Players will utilize powerful card combos to overcome the opposition and gain freedom. Gamble your way out of hell in Black Jacket, available now for PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
